gloss_en: Shaddai — the Divine Name (שַׁדַּי), expounded as 'He Who said to His world: Enough (dai)' and 'there is enough in My Godliness for every creature'; associated with the covenant (brit), Shabbat-rest, and tzimtzum (constriction)

outliers.actual_gloss_en: field (poetic form of שָׂדֶה), as in 'ziz sadai' — the creature/bird of the field (Ps. 50:11), here darshened as the Supernal Unification
outliers.reason: Vocalized with sin (שָׂדַי), part of the Ziz-bird midrash on 'זיז שדי' — the word 'field', a homograph of the Divine Name שַׁדַּי, even though the drash plays on the resemblance
